create_SearchPathElement: create a SearchPathElement with a provider name and search path string
create_SearchPathQuery: create a SearchPathQuery dataclass with optional provider and path fields for anchoring
review_ConfigSearchPath_get_path: review the ConfigSearchPath abstract base class get_path method returning a mutable sequence of SearchPathElement
review_ConfigSearchPath_append: review the ConfigSearchPath append method to add a provider and path to the search path
review_ConfigSearchPath_prepend: review the ConfigSearchPath prepend method to add a provider and path before an optional anchor
